Security & Compliance

Designed with healthcare security at its core.

Implanr treats every case record like it belongs to a real person — because it does. HIPAA-compliant architecture, immutable audit trails, and defence-in-depth engineering, from the login screen down to the database.

Security Features

Defence-in-depth, phase by phase.

HIPAA-compliant architecture
Designed from the ground up to meet HIPAA's Security Rule requirements.
Role-based access control
Every user sees only the data their role requires. No shared workstation accounts.
15-minute automatic logout
Inactivity closes the session across web and native mobile.
JWT authentication
Modern token-based auth with per-device revocation.
Encrypted cloud storage
AES-256 encryption at rest. TLS 1.3 in transit.
Immutable audit logs
Every action, timestamped and un-editable. CSV export in one click.
PDF export logging
Every generated PDF is logged with user, timestamp, and IP.
Digital signatures
Every approval and document is signed and cryptographically bound.
Timestamped approvals
Chronological audit trail of every case decision.
Screenshot protection
Native iOS & Android APIs render screenshots blank on supported platforms.
PHI protection for AI features
PHI never leaves your tenant boundary. AI processes data with strict isolation.

Security-first, for real.

Full compliance documentation, BAA, and vendor questionnaires available for institutional customers.
